title: Open-closed exact sequence for sheaves on a Noetherian space
statement: Let X be a Noetherian topological space (meaning every nonempty set of closed subsets has a minimal element for inclusion), let j:U \to X be the inclusion of an open subset with closed complement i:Z \to X, and let F be an abelian sheaf on X [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. There is a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves 0 \to j_!j^*F \to F \to i_*i^*F \to 0. Moreover j_!j^*F is the direct image along a closed immersion of a sheaf on the closure of U, so its cohomology is computed on that closed subspace [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward].

proof.text: Construct the presheaf counit q by summing identity maps over inclusions V→U. Naturality is proved on direct-sum injections using the restriction formula. Lift q through sheafification to a:G→F. The toSheafify_sheafifyLift identity gives the required formula on every injection.
Apply the canonical slice-site open-closed exactness lemma to a and its injection formula.
Put i:closure(U)→X and F′=i^{-1}G. The proved closure-unit theorem gives an isomorphism e:G≅i_*F′.

The closure inclusion is a closed embedding. Apply closed-immersion cohomology comparison to F′. Compose its degree-p isomorphism with the map of e inverse under the cohomology presheaf functor evaluated at the top open. This yields precisely the requested cohomology isomorphism with G.
